response.overview: Upon discovering that he is about to become a father, a young filmmaker turns his camera toward himself and his longtime girlfriend, a film producer, documenting the challenges of starting a family. As marriage, parenthood, and mounting debts reshape their lives, the couple navigates the uncertainties and responsibilities of adulthood. Over two years, the camera captures moments of profound joy and unexpected sorrow, from the birth of their daughter to the sudden death of the director’s father, offering an intimate portrait of love, loss, and the complexities of family life.
